title: Quasi-coherence of each truncated higher image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and $a,q\in\mathbf Z$. Then the module sheaf $H^q(Rf_*\tau_{\ge a}E)$ is quasi-coherent, where $Rf_*$ is [def-pc-derived-direct-image] and $\tau_{\ge a}$ is the standard lower truncation [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category].

source.place: Lemma 36.4.1 proof, bounded-below paragraph; ordinary higher-image quasi-coherence is Tag 01XJ, part (1)

proof.text: First put T = tau_{>=a} E. Its cohomology is quasi-coherent by DerivedCategory.homologyProperty_truncGE from [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], using that the zero sheaf is the free sheaf on the empty set. T is bounded below by a. Choose a strictly bounded-below representative K of T using DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isGE. Package K as CochainComplex.Plus and obtain homology vanishing below a from exactAt_of_isGE. Apply exists_truncationHypercohomology [thm-sp-truncation-e2] to RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage. Its unbounded right derived functor is definitionally schemeDerivedDirectImage [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. The E2 comparison identifies the nonnegative-first-index terms with ordinary higher images of the quasi-coherent H^j(K).

Use [lem-pc-ordinary-higher-image-quasi-coherent], the acyclic ordinary higher-image interface, to make every nonnegative-first-index E2 term quasi-coherent. The two module pushforward functors and their ordinary right derived functors are definitionally compatible. Negative first-index terms are zero by [thm-sp-truncation-e2] and hence quasi-coherent: the free sheaf on the empty set supplies the zero object for this object property. No compactness of the target or uniform higher-direct-image vanishing bound is used.

Apply the generalized property_pages helper: for an arbitrary object property P of any abelian category, closure under kernels and cokernels propagates P from E2 to all finite pages by induction on pageCouple r. The successor E-term is the cokernel of the incoming differential lifted into the kernel of the outgoing differential. Instantiate P with quasi-coherence, kernel closure with [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-kernel], and cokernel closure with [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image]. Since page r is pageCouple (r-2), every finite page has quasi-coherent terms.

For each integer n, use the abutment filtration FH n of [thm-sp-truncation-e2]. It is full at index 0 and zero at N = max(0,n-a+1). For p<0 its graded piece is zero. For p>=0 the supplied isomorphisms grc.symm followed by psi identify its graded piece with a finite page term, hence quasi-coherent. Apply property_of_shifted_filtration, generalized to a full step at any integer b, zero at b+N, and graded-piece hypotheses only for b <= p < b+N. Descend from the zero step: induct on k <= N to prove the property of step(b+N-k), using its short exact cokernel sequence and extension closure [lem-pc-quasi-coherent-extension]. At k=N, transport along the top subobject isomorphism. Instantiate b=0 for FH n. The case N=0 follows directly from the zero step. This gives quasi-coherence of H n.

Evaluate the preceding result at the requested q. Transport from H q to H^q(Rf_* QK) by the spectral-sequence hH equality and then along the image of the representative isomorphism T ≅ QK under Rf_*. This proves precisely H^q(Rf_* tau_{>=a} E), without restating the existing theorem about every bounded-below derived object.

theorem truncated_higherImage_isQuasicoherent
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (a q : ℤ) :
    ((schemeHigherDirectImage f q).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE a).obj E.obj)).IsQuasicoherent
